value.rationale: The original map was studied precisely to characterize changes in two-cycle bifurcation behavior as its hyperbolic double-well is reshaped; numerical radii do not reveal a complete global count. This theorem gives a nontrivial sharp shape threshold with a finite coexistence region, a saddle-center pairing of periodic orbits, a codimension-two fourth-root onset, and a motivated quantitative fold-width constant. The invariant is a natural symmetry-defined orbit family of the published map, not an arbitrary discrete test or a routine parameter substitution.
